Multi-Device Hub & Synchronization

Discover and control multiple WLED lights on your local network, switch targets seamlessly, or link all lights together with real-time UDP broadcast sync!

UDP Broadcast Group Sync

WLED Multi-Device Sync Protocol (Port 21324)
Broadcast Commands (Sync Send) Mirrors all color, brightness, effects & music sync to other WLED devices on LAN
Listen for Commands (Sync Receive) Allows this device to follow commands sent by other WLED remotes

Devices assigned to the same sync group update simultaneously in sub-millisecond sync.

LED Hardware Calibration & Color Order

Color Calibration
Fix inverted red/green color channels and eliminate the persistent green tint of 5050 LED diodes

💡 If your LEDs look green when you select red, tap RGB above to instantly invert Red and Green.

Verify that each button lights up its exact matching color on your physical strip.

76% (Anti-Green SMD5050)

5050 Green diodes produce ~2.5x more photopic lumens than red/blue, causing a natural green cast on pure whites. This filter scales down green to achieve genuine neutral/warm white.
